svg.aria-label: Three evenly-spaced vertical bars on a deep navy field, the outer two in muted slate with copper-gold edges and the middle one in confident electric blue with a faint purple glow.
svg.title: What attorneys need to know about AI — three architectural decisions
svg.desc: An abstract typographic-feeling triad: three vertical bars of equal height, evenly spaced across the centered band of the frame. The outer two are rendered in muted slate with a subtle copper-gold edge highlight; the middle bar is rendered as a solid confident electric-blue column with a faint soft-purple glow halo behind it — three architectural decisions held together as a triad.
